description: Which jurisdictions' codified law is loaded, and how big and current it is (GET /v1/statutes/coverage): per state the number of codes, sections, bill links and the edition it is current through. Pass state to list that state's codes (GET /v1/statutes/codes) — the code_id values used by get_statute lookups. Call this first to know whether a state's statutes are available.

state.description: 2-letter postal code (e.g. NJ), DC, GU, or US for the U.S. Code.
